Name: Abigail Cat Girl - Town NPC
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[font=Georgia][size=6][color=#9900ff][b][i][u][center]﻿
Abigail Cat Girl[/center][/u][/i][/b][/color][/size]


[size=3]This mod changes Abigail's appearance by giving her cat ears and tail. She will have them at all times, from the dances to the wedding![/size]
[size=3](The mod does not include a modified portrait, whoever wishes to do so is totally free to do so. No credits needed).[/size]

[color=#00ff00][size=5][b][i][u]
The mod has two modes:[/u][/i][/b][/size][/color]
[/font][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]No Bowlegs: Replace the entire Abigail model with one without bowlegs and without the bow on her head.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]Compatibility: Just add the ears and tail. Useful if you use a mod that changes Abigail's appearance, such as Seasonal Outfits Mod.[/size][/font]
[/list][font=Georgia][size=3]


[/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=4][b][i]Nothing else to add, download the mod, unzip it and move it to the Mods folder of the game.[/i][/b][/size][/font]

Downloads.Description: Unzip in Mods folder. Endorse Baby!
